items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that suits oily, sensitive-feeling skin without stripping it.
Lightweight hydration to help skin look smoother and more supple, which supports the look of texture.
A gentle ceramide moisturizer to support the skin barrier and comfort without feeling heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection that is gentle on sensitive-feeling skin.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 15% lactic acid serum for now because it is a high-strength exfoliating acid, so please check with your prenatal provider before adding it. Cleanse, hydrate and moisturize morning and night, and finish with the SPF each morning.
